verdict: Lead volume collapsed this week; we're auditing campaigns and fixing intake now.
narrative: This period you received 17 leads at an average cost per lead of $149.73 — but the last 7 days accounted for only 1 of those leads, a sharp drop from 6 the prior 7 days, while cost per lead spiked 652% week-over-week. Spend continued climbing (up 25% week-over-week to roughly $115/day), which means the issue is not budget — campaign settings and lead intake are the two places that matter right now. At the same time, 100 opportunities are sitting in your pipeline with zero appointments booked and zero closed, pointing to a gap in who is receiving and responding to incoming leads. We're auditing the Google Ads and Local Services campaign for any bid, budget, or targeting changes that may have choked lead flow, and confirming who owns lead intake so that speed-to-lead follow-up is active. Resolving the intake ownership is the gate that must open before any budget increase makes sense.

average cost per lead over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Lead intake has no confirmed owner since the dispatch role was vacated, leaving automated follow-up pointing at an empty seat and pipeline stalling.
watch_item.fix: Intake ownership is being confirmed this week so that lead follow-up automations are active and no inbound lead goes unanswered.
